ai.title: ASMS and BITS Pilani Sign Strategic MoU to Build India's Next-Generation Rural Digital Ecosystem
ai.description: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited (ASMS), formerly known as Bartronics India Limited, signed a strategic MoU with BITS Pilani on 15th May 2026 to co-develop an integrated rural digital ecosystem. The partnership targets more than 40 million farmers and rural residents, leveraging AI, ML, IoT, Blockchain, and advanced data analytics. Key focus areas include digital inclusion, e-governance, financial inclusion, agri-tech, and healthcare access, with early-stage projects covering crop yield prediction pilots and digital financial literacy initiatives. The collaboration is positioned as a model for industry-academia partnerships aimed at delivering measurable social and economic impact across rural India.
